title: EV Charger Installation Maintenance Log Form
subtitle: An original ev charger installation workflow that carries planned or condition-based maintenance through safe release, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete ev charger installation maintenance log form for the electric vehicle charging site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when service personnel need one record for maintenance trigger, asset baseline, work-control references, recurring events, readings, deferred defects, and qualified return-to-service approval. The charging deployment coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: EV charger installation maintenance log identity and ownership
sections.guidance: Define the maintained system, service interval, operating owner, and review period.

sections.title: EV charger installation asset baseline and maintenance readiness
sections.guidance: Reconcile the exact asset and known condition before maintenance or testing begins.

blocks.label: Planned maintenance task set
items: Verify charger, circuit, panel, and parking-space identities
Coordinate planned outage and affected-party notification
Install mounting, foundation, or wall support within approved scope
Install raceway, conductors, disconnect, and circuit identification
Complete grounding, bonding, and protective-device checks
Install impact protection, signage, striping, and cord management
Configure network, payment, access control, and remote monitoring
Perform qualified electrical test and representative charging session
Document as-built route, settings, labels, and equipment serials
Handoff operating instructions, support path, and open limitations

sections.title: EV charger installation work control and safe service boundary
sections.guidance: Record the qualified roles and controlling references; do not use this log as the controlling procedure.

blocks.label: Service readiness confirmations
items: Current procedure, manufacturer information, and applicable requirements were reviewed
Asset boundaries, every energy source, and affected systems were identified
Authorized, affected, contractor, and operations roles were coordinated
Isolation, stored-energy control, and verification references are complete
Required tools, instruments, parts, and protective controls are available
Test, temporary energization, and return-to-service steps have explicit authority
Customer, public, traffic, environmental, and critical-service impacts are controlled
Stop conditions and emergency escalation path are understood

blocks.label: Maintenance stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not an energized-work permit or energy-control procedure. Stop when exposed parts, unknown circuits, failed protection, water intrusion, heat, smoke, or impact damage is present. A qualified and authorized person must control isolation, testing, commissioning, and return to service under current site procedures and applicable requirements. Maintenance stays restricted when isolation, stored energy, system condition, or work scope is unknown. Only the designated authorized person may direct changes to controls and the qualified release owner may approve return to service.

sections.title: EV charger installation maintenance events, condition, and readings
sections.guidance: Create a traceable history of work completed, condition found, evidence, and deferred action.

fields.label: Wear pattern, recurring fault, consumable trend, configuration change, and supporting evidence

sections.title: EV charger installation exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Exposed or damaged energized component, conductor, connector, or enclosure
Arcing, smoke, abnormal heat, burning odor, or repeated protective trip
Water intrusion, standing water, flood exposure, or damaged seals
Vehicle impact, unstable mounting, sharp edge, or falling equipment
Uncontrolled circuit, unknown backfeed, or incomplete energy isolation
Grounding, bonding, or protective-device result outside approved criteria
Pedestrian, accessible-route, traffic, or cord trip exposure
Work beyond the assigned qualified person's authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not an energized-work permit or energy-control procedure. Stop when exposed parts, unknown circuits, failed protection, water intrusion, heat, smoke, or impact damage is present. A qualified and authorized person must control isolation, testing, commissioning, and return to service under current site procedures and applicable requirements.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each maintenance exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: EV charger installation decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Electric vehicle charging site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
